en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:
‘The hand of the thief would be cut and his thumb would be left alone along with the centre of the palm; and his leg would be cut and his sole would be left alone so he can walk upon it’.
